title: Kakie Pangilinan on KC Concepcion: ‘Every family naman has conflict’
summary: Kakie Pangilinan acknowledged that there is a strain in her relationship with half-sister KC Concepcion. But she made one thing clear: she still loves her. “Every family naman has conflict, you know,…

blocks.text: Kakie Pangilinan acknowledged that there is a strain in her relationship with half-sister KC Concepcion. But she made one thing clear: she still loves her. “Every family naman has conflict, you know, and we’re working on it,” Kakie said in an interview with Ogie Diaz. Kakie was asked about KC amid observations that they have not been in communication for quite some time. She did not go into the details of what happened, choosing to keep some matters within the family. But she was candid about how she sees KC. “I love her very much. I love my sister very much and I think I can say I miss my sister very much,” Kakie said. She also pushed back against the idea that she treats KC differently because they are only half-sisters. “Never ko pong naisip na half-sister ko siya,” she said, adding that while they are biologically half-sisters, she has always considered KC her sister. Kakie also shared that even with the distance between them, KC remains part of the family in her mind. She recalled how she would include KC’s name whenever she ordered birthday cakes for her parents. The distance, however, is real. Kakie admitted that they have not seen or spoken to each other for a long time. She also made a distinction between having disagreements and having a full-blown family fight. “Hindi naman porket disagreements automatic na fight or away na agad,” she said. Kakie said there are also plenty of things being said about their family online that do not necessarily reflect what actually happened. It remains to be seen whether KC will respond to Kakie’s first extended public remarks about their relationship.
